references.text: The great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength - the foundation of the command in Deuteronomy 11:1
Parallel text requiring fear and love of the Lord, walking in his ways, and keeping his commands
Moses commands the people to love the Lord, walk in his ways, and keep his commands, statutes, and laws
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord and keep his commands, as Moses commanded
David's exhortation to Solomon to keep the Lord's statutes, commands, laws, and testimonies
Jesus quotes the greatest commandment: to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind
Jesus restates the command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength
Jesus links love for him with keeping his commands
Love for God is shown by keeping his commands, and his commands are not burdensome
